metadata.coverage_intent: Coverage MCP selected the false size-error arms in the WASM PostScript hinting wrapper. WinFNT is a valid bitmap face, while the maintained render size deliberately misses its single 8-pixel strike, so FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes returns Invalid_Pixel_Size before glyph loading.

Coverage MCP selected the direct file_base null guard in fontdone_wasm_ps_hinting_engine_open. One hundred labeled variants execute the real WASM invalid-argument return while Rust, C ABI, and the offline oracle preserve the same explicit safety contract; prune by measured line and region delta.

Coverage MCP selected the null output-pointer guard after the file pointer guard in fontdone_wasm_ps_hinting_engine_open. One hundred labeled variants keep file_base non-null, execute the real WASM Invalid_Argument return, and compare the same explicit safety contract across Rust, C ABI, and the offline oracle; prune by measured line and region delta.

Coverage MCP selected the false post-error preservation branch in the WASM PostScript hinting facade. One hundred valid CFF, Type 1, and CID variants vary engine selection, strings, glyphs, sizes, and load flags so a successful first load can be compared with a changed or failed second load; prune by measured source delta.

Five existing valid CFF Type 2 random-charstring variants plus fourteen source-reviewed CFF Private-dictionary cases exercise the post-error preservation route and cover omitted Private, zero offset, seed parsing, parser boundary, harmless unterminated-real, and malformed escaped-operator behavior at src/tt/cff.rs:465-523, subject to exact C/Rust/WASM parity.

Four valid PostScript font variants deliberately make the first glyph load fail with an out-of-range glyph index, and one valid WinFNT bitmap variant misses its only strike so FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes fails, exercising the WASM wrapper's defensive first-error and second-error preservation branch with exact Rust, C ABI, and WASM comparison.

variants.reason: Use random_seed 65535 so pinned FreeType's first CFF random value has low 16 bits 0xffff and selects biased global subroutine 108 (out of range), while cff_random at psobjs.c:2552-2559 makes the second load select biased subroutine 107 (valid); this is the missing first-error/second-success post-validation branch.

metadata.coverage_intent: Five valid CFF Type 2 variants use random followed by eq to select global subroutine 107 on the first load and out-of-range subroutine 108 on the reload; one additional valid variant reverses that transition with random_seed 65535, making the first load fail and the reload succeed. The fixed public seeds make both C state transitions deterministic while Type 1 and CID companion loads remain valid controls.
